invoice_item_id.description: line_item_id of the underlying items in the invoice. This node is used when an invoice (of a sales order) or a sales return is converted to a credit note. Along with this node, the invoice_id and the is_item_shipped nodes are mandatory to create a credit note from an invoice and the nodes invoice_id, is_item_shipped, is_returned_to_stock and salesreturn_item_id are required to create a credit note from sales return.

is_item_shipped.description: Defines the shipping status of the line item in the corresponding sales order. The value of this node should be 'True' in order to create a credit note from sales return since a sales return can only be created for shipped goods. The value of this node should be 'False' to create a credit note from an invoice since the unshipped items are allowed to be cancelled in the sales order. Along with this node, invoice_id and invoice_item_id nodes are mandatory to create a credit note from an invoice and the nodes invoice_id, invoice_item_id, is_returned_to_stock and salesreturn_item_id are required to create a credit note from sales return.

is_returned_to_stock.description: Defines the receivability of the items in the sales return. For example, if a sales return has been raised for five units of an item where three units are receivable and two are credit-only, then that sales return line item has to be split in to two line items in the credit note - receivable quantity and the credit-only quantity. The value of this node has to be true for receivable line item and false for credit-only line item in Credit note. Along with this node, invoice_id, invoice_item_id, is_item_shipped, salesreturn_item_id are also needed to create credit note from Sales Return.

salesreturn_item_id.description: line_item_id of the underlying items in the sales return. This node is needed for converting sales return to credit note. Other nodes such as invoice_id, invoice_item_id, is_item_shipped, is_returned_to_stock are also needed to create credit note from Sales Return.

Two schedule types are supported: auto (system-generated schedule based on recurrence frequency) and manual (user-specified count dates). organization_id.description: Which organisation to act on (its organization_id). Leave out when the login has just one; Emplio fills it in.

end_date.description: Optional for auto schedule. The end date of the recurrence in YYYY-MM-DD format. Mutually exclusive with no_of_cycles.

no_of_cycles.description: Optional for auto schedule. The maximum number of count cycles. Mutually exclusive with end_date.

recurrence_frequency.description: Required for auto schedule. Frequency unit for recurrence. Allowed values: days, weeks, months.

repeat_every.description: Required for auto schedule. Interval value for recurrence (e.g., 1 for every 1 month).

count_dates.description: Required for manual schedule. List of specific count dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

execution_time.description: Time of day at which the count should be triggered, in HH:mm (24-hour) format. Applies to both auto and manual schedules. Defaults to 00:00 if not specified.

run_specific_week.description: For auto schedule with recurrence_frequency: months. The week of the month to run the count. Allowed values: first, second, third, fourth, last.

run_specific_month.description: For auto schedule. Specific month of the year to run the count (e.g., january).

line_items.description: Products to count in each generated count. Each line item requires an item_id. Duplicate products are not allowed.

item_id.description: Unique ID of the product (item) in the line item.

inventorycount_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the stock count line item.

organization_id.description: Which organisation to act on (its organization_id). Leave out when the login has just one; Emplio fills it in.

filter_by.description: Filter tracking entries by status. Allowed values: Status.All (default, all entries), Status.Missing (serial/batch numbers present in the system but not counted), Status.NewlyAdded (serial/batch numbers counted but not present in the system).

search_text.description: Search term to filter tracking entries by serial number or batch number.

page.description: Page number. Default is 1.

per_page.description: Number of records per page. Default is 1000.

actions.name: list_storage_details_for_count_item
actions.description: List storage details for a count item. Retrieves all storage location (bin) details for a specific product (item) that has been added to a stock count. This is used for items that are tracked by storage/bin location. Returns basic storage info when the count is in yet_to_start status; returns system quantities, counted quantities, variances, and serial/batch tracking details once counting has started.

inventorycount_id.description: Unique identifier of the stock count.

item_id.description: Unique identifier of the product (item) whose storage bin details are to be retrieved.

organization_id.description: Which organisation to act on (its organization_id). Leave out when the login has just one; Emplio fills it in.

page.description: Page number to be fetched. Default value is 1.

per_page.description: Number of records per page. Default value is 1000.

actions.name: search_items_in_in_progress_stock_counts
actions.description: Search items in in-progress stock counts. Returns a list of stock count line items from in-progress counts, suitable for autocomplete/search UI. Supports filtering by item ID, storage location, warehouse, category, manufacturer, and item type (bin-tracked vs non-bin-tracked). Use the filter_by parameter to filter by item status (e.g., Items.Uncounted) or type (e.g., ItemType.BinTracked, ItemType.NonBinTracked). Use the group_by parameter to group results.

organization_id.description: Which organisation to act on (its organization_id). Leave out when the login has just one; Emplio fills it in.

inventorycount_id.description: Filter results to a specific stock count.

item_id.description: Filter results to a specific item (product).

storage_location_id.description: Filter results to a specific storage location (bin).

warehouse_id.description: Filter results by a specific warehouse ID.

category_ids.description: Comma-separated list of category IDs to filter items.

manufacturer_ids.description: Comma-separated list of manufacturer IDs to filter items.

brand_ids.description: Comma-separated list of brand IDs to filter items.

filter_by.description: Filter items by status or type. Allowed values: Items.Uncounted (only uncounted items), ItemType.BinTracked (only bin-tracked items), ItemType.NonBinTracked (only non-bin-tracked items).

group_by.description: Groups the results by the specified field (e.g., item_id).

search_text.description: Search term to filter items by name or SKU.

page.description: Page number. Default value is 1.

per_page.description: Number of records per page. Default value is 200.

actions.name: search_storage_locations_in_in_progress_stock_counts
actions.description: Search storage locations in in-progress stock counts. Returns a list of storage locations (bins) from in-progress stock counts, suitable for autocomplete/search UI. Supports filtering by storage location, warehouse/location, item ID, and counted status. Use filter_by=Storages.Uncounted to return only storage locations that have uncounted items.

organization_id.description: Which organisation to act on (its organization_id). Leave out when the login has just one; Emplio fills it in.

inventorycount_id.description: Filter results to a specific stock count.

storage_location_id.description: Filter by a specific storage location.

warehouse_id.description: Filter by a specific warehouse ID.

item_id.description: Filter storage locations that contain a specific item.

filter_by.description: Filter by storage status. Allowed value: Storages.Uncounted to return only storage locations with uncounted items.

search_text.description: Search term to filter storage locations by name.

page.description: Page number. Default value is 1.

per_page.description: Number of records per page. Default value is 200.

group_by.description:
Grouping strategy for picklist items. Controls the shape of `line_items`.
none - flat picklist; each entry is a single pick row with all pick fields supplied directly on the line item.
item - grouped by item; each entry represents one product, with the actual picks supplied as child entries inside `mapping_entity_details`.
sales_order - grouped by sales order; each entry represents one sales order, with picks supplied inside `mapping_entity_details`.
Grouping (`item` / `sales_order`) is supported only when `parent_entity` is `salesorder`. Picklists for `parent_entity=purchase_return` must use `group_by=none`.
Cannot be changed after creation.

assignee_id.description: ID of the user to assign the picklist to.

line_items.description: Picklist line items. Shape depends on `group_by`. Min 1, Max 1000.

items.description:
A line item in a picklist create/update request. Two mutually-exclusive shapes, controlled by `group_by`:

- **Flat (`group_by=none`)** - populate pick fields (`quantity_to_be_picked`, `storages`, `serial_numbers`, `batches`, `status`, `preferred_storage_id`, `item_custom_fields`, the `*_line_item_id` references) directly on this object. Do **not** send `mapping_entity_details`.
- **Grouped (`group_by=item` or `sales_order`)** - only `line_item_id` (on update), `assignee_id` and `mapping_entity_details` are valid here. All actual pick details belong to each child entry inside `mapping_entity_details`.

actions.name: create_vendor_credit
actions.description: Create a vendor credit for a vendor.

organization_id.description: Which organisation to act on (its organization_id). Leave out when the login has just one; Emplio fills it in.

ignore_auto_number_generation.description: Ignore auto number generation for this vendor credit only. On enabling this option vendor credit number is mandatory.

bill_id.description: Bill Associated with the Vendor Credit

vendor_id.description: ID of the vendor the vendor credit associated with the Vendor Credit

vat_treatment.description: VAT treatment for the invoice. VAT treatment denotes the location of the customer, if the customer resides in UK then the VAT treatment is uk. If the vendor is in an EU country & VAT registered, you are resides in Northen Ireland and purchasing Goods then his VAT treatment is eu_vat_registered and if he resides outside the EU then his VAT treatment is overseas(For Pre Brexit, this can be split as eu_vat_registered, eu_vat_not_registered and non_eu).

vendor_credit_number.description: Mandatory if auto number generation is disabled.

gst_treatment.description: Choose whether the contact is GST registered/unregistered/consumer/overseas. Allowed values are business_gst , business_none , overseas , consumer .

tax_treatment.description:
VAT treatment for the vendor credit. Choose whether the vendor falls under: vat_registered,vat_not_registered,gcc_vat_not_registered,gcc_vat_registered,non_gcc.
dz_vat_registered and dz_vat_not_registered are supported only for UAE.
home_country_mexico,border_region_mexico,non_mexico supported only for MX.

gst_no.description: 15 digit GST identification number of the vendor.

source_of_supply.description: Place from where the goods/services are supplied. (If not given, place of contact given for the contact will be taken)

destination_of_supply.description: Place where the goods/services are supplied to. (If not given, organisation's home state will be taken)

place_of_supply.description:
The place of supply is where a transaction is considered to have occurred for VAT purposes. For the supply of goods, the place of supply is the location of the goods when the supply occurs. For the supply of services, the place of supply should be where the supplier is established. (If not given, place of contact given for the contact will be taken)
Supported codes for UAE emirates are :
Abu Dhabi - AB,
Ajman - AJ,
Dubai - DU,
Fujairah - FU,
Ras al-Khaimah - RA,
Sharjah - SH,
Umm al-Quwain - UM.
Supported codes for the GCC countries are :
United Arab Emirates - AE,
Saudi Arabia - SA,
Bahrain - BH,
Kuwait - KW,
Oman - OM,
Qatar - QA.

date.description: The date the vendor credit is created. [yyyy-mm-dd]

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate of the currency.

is_inclusive_tax.description: Used to specify whether the line item rates are inclusive or exclusive of tax.

reverse_charge_tax_id.description: ID of the reverse charge tax

item_order.description: Order of the line item

unit.description: Unit of the line item e.g. kgs, Nos.

tax_id.description: ID of the Tax associated with the Vendor Credit

tds_tax_id.description: TDS Tax ID of the Tax associated with the Vendor Credit

tax_treatment_code.description:
Specify reason for using out of scope.
Supported values for UAE are uae_same_tax_group, uae_reimbursed_expense and uae_others.
Supported values for Bahrain are bahrain_same_tax_group, bahrain_transfer_of_concern, bahrain_disbursement, bahrain_head_to_branch_transaction and bahrain_others.

organization_id.description: Which organisation to act on (its organization_id). Leave out when the login has just one; Emplio fills it in.

vendor_credit_number.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit number. Variants: vendor_credit_number_startswith and vendor_credit_number_contains

date.description: General Format: yyyy-mm-dd. Search vendor credits by date. Variants: date.start, date.end, date.before and date.after

status.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit status. Allowed statuses are open, closed and void. Allowed Values: open, closed and void

total.description: Search vendor credits by total amount. Variants: total_start, total_end, total_less_than, total_less_equals, total_greater_than and total_greater_equals

item_description.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit item description. Variants: item_description_startswith and item_description_contains

notes.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit notes. Variants: notes_startswith and notes_contains

custom_field.description: Search vendor credits by custom field. Variants : custom_field_startswith and custom_field_contains

last_modified_time.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit last modfified time

customer_id.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit customer ID

line_item_id.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit line item ID

item_id.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit item ID

tax_id.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit tax ID

filter_by.description: Filter vendor credits by statuses. Allowed Values: Status.All, Status.Open, Status.Draft, Status.Closed and Status.Void.

search_text.description: Search vendor credits by vendor credit number or vendor name or vendor credit reference number.

sort_column.description: Sort vendor credits by following columns vendor_name, vendorcredit_number, balance, total, date and created_time. Allowed Values: vendor_name, vendor_credit_number, balance, total, date, created_time, last_modified_time and reference_number.

sort_order.description: A for ascending, D for descending

page.description: Page number to be fetched. Default value is 1.
